It was added after seeing 2026-11-19, so that day cannot promote it. Momentum’s point estimate is positive, and its 90% interval still includes zero, so that gain is not clear. Late favorites in the 2 to 5 minute window are a small gain; the 5 to 10 minute bucket lost and the sample is thinner. Buckets under 20 trades are noise.
No champion was replaced. The only day so far is still unfinished as a holdout. The edge gate was not touched. Live execution stays off.
